decisions.evidence: 9.205: the measured heap rule (13.7 + 3,600 x fraction GiB) and the 0.1 % case's trip times; docs/scaling.md; the reference city's 25 % arms peak at 26.2 GiB for 155,000 agents (9.169)
decisions.answer: Measure a leaner agent first on a 1 % case, then decide the host (recommended)

decisions.question: Both 1 % Mumbai cases gridlock with the transit fleet's road space scaled (114,414-122,192 of 269,690 agents removed stuck): at 0.01 every link is a gate of one vehicle per 200 s with storage for one, and 41.5 % of the network's nodes are pass-through, so merging them doubles a 65 m median link to about 130 m - still a sixth of a vehicle's storage at 1 %. Memory is no longer the first constraint (31 GiB at 1 %, 55 at 2 %, 247 at 10 % on this 63 GB host). Which way to a fraction a reading can stand on?

options.label: Merge the degree-2 link chains and re-run the 1 % case as the diagnostic, then take the host if the stuck share holds
options.detail: cheap and informative (~1 h of builds, a 1.3 h case): if spillback on short links is the mechanism the stuck share falls; the arithmetic says it cannot fall to the reference city's order at 1 %, so this is the evidence the host option is priced on, not a substitute for it

options.label: A larger host (cloud or workstation, 384-512 GB) for a 10 % core, after the merge diagnostic (recommended)
options.detail: the MATSim literature's floor for a congested network is about 10 %: 2.7 M agents, 247 GiB live at plan memory 5, an iteration of hours on 8 threads; a probe on that host prices the arm before any approval; the merged network halves the links it routes on

decisions.answer: A larger host (cloud or workstation, 384-512 GB) for a 10 % core, after the merge diagnostic (recommended)

decisions.question: The OGD platform holds MMRDA's daily ridership of Metro Lines 2A and 7 (1 January 2024 - 19 September 2025) and the Monorail (1 October 2024 - 21 September 2025) - the first operator ridership by line for the second city. The API needs a personal key; the shared sample key is rate-limited for everyone. Register one?

options.label: Register a free OGD account at data.gov.in and put its key in .env as OGD_API_KEY (recommended)
options.detail: the adapter reads the key from .env, sends it as the api-key parameter and never records it; both series land in one command

options.label: Hold the two series unobtained
options.detail: the metro target stays derived from the CTS split alone

decisions.evidence: 9.207: ogd_mmrda_ridership_catalog_20260922 (the catalog listing, acquired); the two keyed entries refuse with the reason
decisions.answer: Register a free OGD account at data.gov.in and put its key in .env as OGD_API_KEY (recommended)

decisions.question: 40 catalogued sources sit on hosts that refuse this machine: MMMOCL, Central and Western Railway, RDSO and MRVC time out or drop the connection; the DES district pages fail certificate trust; TRTI, MoSPI and NMMC time out. The same hosts failed on 21 and 22 September under both transports, so this reads as a geographic restriction, not an outage. Which route?

options.label: Capture them in a browser and import each through import_browser_acquisition.py (recommended)
options.detail: the validator checks the captured HTTPS response against the catalogue; works from any network the browser reaches

options.label: Run acquire_sources.py from an Indian network (a VPS or a VPN endpoint)
options.detail: one scripted pass; the provenance records the transport

options.label: Leave them unobtained and lodge the data requests instead
options.detail: the ledger keeps them as gaps; BEST's request is drafted already

decisions.evidence: 9.207: the retry log data/raw/_acquisition_attempts.json of 22 September 2026
decisions.answer: Capture them in a browser and import each through import_browser_acquisition.py (recommended)
decisions.note: 22 September 2026: a scratch Edge on this machine is refused too (MMMOCL ERR_CONNECTION_TIMED_OUT, Central Railway ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED), so the block is on the address, not the client; the capture must be made from a network the hosts admit (an Indian VPN endpoint in the browser)
